items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: He was playing second trumpet with me. ... Buddy played with us a long time.

ctx.x: Okay. Do you remember some of your other jobs or other bands you played in after after that Melenberg job then? Well I mean I had several bands because I mean on

a little before Buddy Petit. Buddy Petit was playing with me too. He worked with me too. Oh and in your band then? That's right. He was playing second trumpet with me. Buddy Petit. When he died Buddy Petit died on the 4th of July. That he was supposed to go away with me that morning. When I went to his house he was dying. Alright. That's Sunday. That's Sunday. The 4th of July. No he was sick I mean but not he thought he would have been able to make it. When I went there that morning he was dying. When we come…
